    • createMessageID

      public String createMessageID()
      Creates a unique 10-digit message ID using random number generation. The ID is zero-padded to always be exactly 10 digits long.
      Returns:
      String containing 10-digit message ID

    • checkMessageID

      public boolean checkMessageID()
      Validates that the message ID is not more than 10 characters long. This ensures the ID meets the length requirement for storage.
      Returns:
      true if message ID length is 10 or less, false otherwise

    • checkRecipientCell

      public boolean checkRecipientCell()
      Validates recipient cell phone number format. Must start with international code +27 and be exactly 12 characters long. Note: Invalid numbers are still stored per POE specification.
      Returns:
      true if recipient number is valid format, false otherwise

    • createMessageHash

      public String createMessageHash()
      Creates a unique message hash using string manipulation. Format: first 2 digits of ID + message number + first word + last word (all caps) Example: "12:3:HELLOWORLD"
      Returns:
      String containing the formatted message hash

    • sentMessage

      public String sentMessage(String choice)
      Processes the message based on user's choice and populates parallel arrays.
      Parameters:
      choice - The user's selection: "Send", "Store", or "Discard"
      Returns:
      Result message indicating what happened to the message, including Message ID and Hash for Send/Store operations

    • printMessages

      public String printMessages()
      Displays individual message details for a SINGLE message instance.
      Returns:
      Formatted string containing Message ID, Hash, Recipient, and Message text

    • returnTotalMessages

      public static int returnTotalMessages()
      Returns the total number of messages created (not just sent).
      Returns:
      int count of all Message objects created

    • storeMessage

      public void storeMessage()
      Stores the current message to the messages.json file. Attribution: json-simple library - https://code.google.com/archive/p/json-simple/ Each message is written as one JSON object per line for easy reading.
